Crispy, Garlicky & ridiculously addictive Salt & Pepper Paneer!
Crispy paneer tossed with lots of garlic, chillies, onions and that simple salt & pepper seasoning… this one is an absolute banger!
Perfect as a quick starter, party snack or whenever you’re craving some restaurant-style Indo-Chinese food at home. The paneer stays beautifully crisp on the outside and soft inside, and the final toss brings everything together in minutes.
Definitely give this one a try and enjoy!
